basePrompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Edit the provided character sheet; it is the exact EDIT TARGET, not merely a style reference.
User request: make a military-cap variant with a small rank/ribbon-like badge attached to the FRONT of the cap.
Change only the headwear: add the specified military cap to the SAME man in ALL THREE poses. Preserve his exact face identity, expression, eyeglasses if any, head tilt, hands, body, uniform, colors, silhouette below the neck, desk, camera, coarse pixel size, layout, three equal columns and transparent alpha background. The front badge must be legible at this pixel scale. Use simple invented geometric rank decoration rather than any real unit logo, flag, coat of arms, lettering or name.
The cap must sit naturally on the head and rotate with his head pose, with an unmistakable crown, band and short front brim; keep the eyes, eyebrows and glasses visible. Preserve portions of side hair as appropriate. All three caps must have the SAME badge shape/count. Do not add chest ribbons, medals, extra insignia on the uniform or equipment. Keep the existing 1536x1024 canvas with equal three 512x1024 pose cells; keep each desk in place; no clipping.
Match the EXISTING coarse low-resolution pixel art and thick dark stair-step outline. No smooth rendering, fine detailed fabric, gradients, extra glow, title text, labels or watermarks. Exactly three states remain: intro / thinking / AI defeat. Preserve genuine transparent background and gaps.
